basic_info.description: Located in one of San Francisco's fastest growing neighborhoods is a well laid out 2bd/2ba + den at The Arden. As you enter one feels an immense sense of openness & light, coming from the south facing windows. The chef's kitchen features integrated cabinetry, luxury Thermador appliances, a long eat-in island, seamlessly opening up to the dining & living areas. There is a sizable enclosed den which can be used as an office or third bedroom alternative. Off of the living room is a patio with views of the park. The primary bedroom is spacious & has two custom closets, a large bathroom with separate shower & soaking tub. The guest bedroom is located on the opposite end of the home. There is an additional bathroom & in-unit vented laundry. #302 also comes with storage & a premium parking space, with EV charger conveniently located on the same level as the residence. The Arden is best known for its luxury amenities, with 24/7 doorman, pool, fitness center, club room, BBQ area. There is a new second gym which has just opened in the building. Across the street is a pet & children's park. Just around the block, construction is starting for a elementary school, which will have Pre-K through 5th grade.
